description: Reverse engineer browser extensions (Chrome/Edge MV2/MV3, Firefox) for an authorized review: unpack .crx/.xpi, assess the permission surface, trace background/service-worker and content-script logic, and recover credential, signing, or traffic-handling behavior. Load on "analyze this extension", extension supply-chain or malicious-extension investigation, or keys hidden in chrome.storage.
